name: smwmusic-china-warrior-game-over
title: China Warrior - Game Over
description:
Did an port of the Death Jingle from China Warrior (aka The Kung Fu in Japan) for the TurboGrafx-16 / PC-Engine. Really fitting for any eastern themed romhacks.

Important:
There's an option to enable or disable the SMW death SFX at the beginning:
ㅤ0. No Death SFX [turned on by default]
ㅤ1. Death SFX


Mod Note: If using this as a global song (such as the death or game over songs), you will need to add ! to the line featuring @14 in Addmusic_sample_groups.txt for it to sound as intended.

Update:
Added an option to change the sample in the song (for those who want to use it globally w/o any workarounds):
ㅤ1. @1 (Works globally by default) [turned on by default]
ㅤ2. @14
